structure: repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend at main 4c2119da (tag 0.286.0); every path in `read` is relative to that repo root. The live-animals notification journey is one set, src/server/app/sets/live-animals, about 31,900 non-unit-test lines including src/server/app/shared. Its one journey style, journeys/linear, has 21 feature folders under journeys/linear/features (dashboard, hub, origin, commodities [search, consignment-details, animal-identification], import-reason, additional-details, documents, addresses [party-picker, party-edit, address-return], cph-number, transport [port-of-entry, transit-countries, transporters, transporter-add, transporters-select, commercial-transporter-details, private-transporter-details], contact, check-answers, declaration, confirmation, cancel-amend, notification-actions, delete-notification, system), each holding page.js, controller(s), Nunjucks templates, validate.js, view-model helpers, an English and a Welsh copy file and its *.fit.spec.js Playwright specs. The flow (journeys/linear/flow: ten sections start, origin, commodities, animalIdentification, consignment, documents, addresses, transport, contact, review) orders the pages; obligations/ (index.js and sections/*.js, about 1,000 lines) declares what each notification must hold, in scope and mandatory; services/commodities is the commodity reference service and its stub; docs/ holds the set's recipe and model docs. Shared layout and copy live in src/server/app/shared (layout.njk, kit.js, copy.en.js, copy.cy.js, save-actions, error summary, section caption, set-context). The set is mounted by src/server/app/routes-live-animals.js. The repo's decisions ledger is src/server/app/docs/decisions.md (56 lines, architecture decisions, not product rulings); no rulings ledger such as spec/decisions.json exists. One repo-level fit spec, fit/journey-smoke.fit.spec.js, walks the whole journey. Cut into 14 parts by what a user sees: shared layout and flow, the obligation model and ledger, then one part per page group in journey order, with the dashboard and its notification actions as one part. Left out: every *.test.js unit test; the generic platform under src/server/app (engine, model, bridge, flow, lib, analysis, services other than address-book) beyond what a part names; src/server/common, auth and health; the characterisation and reachability fixtures (journeys/linear/fixtures, flow/fixtures, flow/reachability-fixtures), which are test data; coverage/ and build output. Welsh copy files are read for existence and parity only: claims quote the English copy.
